title: Lighthouse in a storm: our second demo made with Claude and LittleJS
author: Slackluster
selftext:
This is the second short demo we've made pairing the LittleJS game engine with Claude, to see what the two can do together. You can play it here, click to call down lightning:

[https://killedbyapixel.github.io/LittleJS-Demos/lighthouse/](https://killedbyapixel.github.io/LittleJS-Demos/lighthouse/)

# What's doing what

All the rendering is LittleJS's own 3D renderer on WebGL2. There's no three.js and no other library. The whole demo is one HTML file with the engine next to it, no build step and no asset files. Everything you see and hear is generated in code when the page loads:

* Sea: a grid moved by waves in a vertex shader, with small chop, foam and rain ripples drawn in the pixel shader.
* Island: one heightfield of ledges and crags, lit by a rock normal map that is itself generated from noise.
* Clouds: each cloud is a single sprite painted from noise with its light baked in, drawn as a lit billboard, so the lightning lights them from inside.
* Lightning: a bolt built by midpoint displacement with branches, plus point lights that light the sea, the rocks and the clouds around each strike.
* Spray: particles thrown up whenever a swell climbs the rocks.
* Sound: rain, wind and the surge of the sea, plus thunder that arrives later and fainter the further away the strike lands. All of it is synthesized when the page loads.

# How we worked

Claude wrote the code. I set the direction and gave several rounds of feedback. Claude checked its own work by driving a headless browser to grab frames at exact times, and by unit testing the math (waves, lightning, sound) in node. It also recorded the video frame by frame. It runs at 60 fps at 1080p.

Source (GPL-3.0): [https://github.com/KilledByAPixel/LittleJS-Demos](https://github.com/KilledByAPixel/LittleJS-Demos)

First demo, Starlings Murmuration: [https://killedbyapixel.github.io/LittleJS-Demos/murmuration/](https://killedbyapixel.github.io/LittleJS-Demos/murmuration/)
